youtube.baslik: Can otoacoustic emissions be low in an ear with normal thresholds? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the example case, distortion product otoacoustic emissions, or DPOAEs, were recorded to assess outer hair cell function in a person with a normal audiogram and tinnitus. In both ears, responses were clearly above the noise floor in the mid frequencies, but between 4000 and 8000 Hz amplitudes were low and borderline at some frequencies. Although thresholds are normal, this finding may suggest an early change in outer hair cell function in the high-frequency region; OAE findings are interpreted not alone, but with other tests and the course over time.
